How it was built

Fixed 100-app seed
Fetch official docs
Schema-constrained LLM extraction
Append-only SQLite passes
Stratified independent verification
Static report + JSON

The primary run uses bounded concurrency (5). When a fetch, model call, or schema validation fails, the record is retained as an explicit blocker and flagged for human review. The finished database is also queryable through the included MCP server.

Verification: hits and misses

199/240 compared fields matched. Verification is an independent re-fetch from a blank extraction context; human spot-check notes remain a required final submission artifact.
